comppattern=re.compile(r"同比(多增|少增|多减|少减)([+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(万亿元|亿元)")
def period_interval(year,quarter,label):
    ytd={1:"一季度",2:"上半年",3:"前三季度",4:"全年"}[quarter]
    if label==ytd or label=="年内":
        return {"native_period":label,"kind":"YEAR_TO_DATE","start":f"{year}-01-01","end":f"{year}-{quarter*3:02d}-{calendar.monthrange(year,quarter*3)[1]:02d}"}
    qlabel={1:"一季度",2:"二季度",3:"三季度",4:"四季度"}[quarter]
    if label in [qlabel,"本季度","当季"]:
        return {"native_period":label,"kind":"NATIVE_SINGLE_QUARTER","start":f"{year}-{(quarter-1)*3+1:02d}-01","end":f"{year}-{quarter*3:02d}-{calendar.monthrange(year,quarter*3)[1]:02d}"}
    return None

        amount=float(match[1])*(10000 if match[2]=="万亿元" else 1)

            slot["flow_status"]="UNKNOWN_PARSE_LOCATION_DISAGREES_WITH_FROZEN_BALANCE";slots.append(slot);flat.append(slot);continue
        start,end=match.span()
        nextstarts=[m.start() for k,m in firstmatches.items() if m.start()>start]
        stop=min(nextstarts) if nextstarts else len(canonical)

        generic_next=list(re.finditer(r"贷款[1-9]?余额(?:为)?[+-]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:万亿元|亿元)",tail))
        boundaries += [m.start() for m in generic_next]

        if boundaries:tail=tail[:min(boundaries)]

        flows=[]

            flows.append({"native_literal":fm.group(),"native_period":fm[1],"native_verb":fm[2],"native_number":float(fm[3]),"native_unit":fm[4],
                    "signed_net_change_yi":signed,"interval":interval,"offset_in_role_tail":fm.start(),"end_in_role_tail":fm.end(),"period_matches_original_quarter":interval is not None})
        slot["candidate_flows_and_periods"]=flows
        current=[f for f in flows if f["period_matches_original_quarter"]]
        if len(current)==0:
